## 专业目录覆盖记录

**已完成所列官方目录范围的对账**，共 165 项；这不是全字段详情的完成状态。

<p><strong>统计范围：</strong>Purdue University official admissions directory for West Lafayette and Indianapolis; each record carries explicit location from its program Quick Facts; excludes other Purdue system institutions</p>

<p><strong>对账方法：</strong>{&quot;pages&quot;: 11, &quot;page_card_counts&quot;: [16, 16, 16, 16, 16, 16, 16, 16, 16, 16, 10], &quot;unique_program_details&quot;: 170, &quot;detail_pages_read&quot;: 170, &quot;pagination&quot;: &quot;GET ?paged=1..11 complete; total 170 unique URLs equals published count; final page10 records. Initial public POST API redirected, so all official GET pages were used instead.&quot;}</p>

<p><strong>排除项：</strong>Read Degree and Location(s) in each of 170 program pages. Keep every named bachelor major and split Anthropology BA/BS. Exclude six exploratory/pre-professional/first-year entry routes even where template Degree field says bachelor. Landscape Architecture pre-entry route is attached to the actual major.</p>

**尚未解决的目录缺口：**

- This is the official undergraduate admissions directory; it does not independently enumerate every internal second-degree route or optional joint-degree combination unless listed as its own major card.
- No claim that an Indianapolis program is physically offered in West Lafayette; campus is explicit per record.
- Duration and language not inferred.

- [官方目录来源](https://admissions.purdue.edu/academics/majors/)
